title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：team　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 team 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the athlete ① built the team that no trainer in the stadium would have counted, and he said the building was the whole of the year. The ② team, meaning the group itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a team, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ team in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ team at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A team, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the athlete said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the team was the whole of the matter, meaning the unity and not the group. The ⑥ team, meaning the unity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; team, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a group and an unity. He said the unity is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ team had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ team of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of counting; team, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ team I remember is the group counted in the programme, which closed in 1988 and is still counted as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ team, my mother said in 1990, is the only group that improves by being counted; every team, she said, is an unity that has agreed to look like a group. She said the unity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 队；团队（指体育场里每一支旁边的那一支）
B. n. 队；团队（指那支队本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the team 组建这一支队
D. n. 队；团队（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 队之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的队之事）
F. n. 队；团队（指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一支）
G. n. 队、齐心（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 齐心（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the team that no trainer in the stadium would have counted
The team, meaning the group itself and not the bib
the team at the far track
the team was the whole of the matter
the team had become a line in a programme
The team of the whole thing
A team, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: build the team 意为“组建这一支队”，1981 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯清点的一支队做了一遍。
team 意为“队；团队”，指那支队本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
team 意为“队；团队”，指体育场里每一支旁边的那一支，每一支旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
team 意为“队；团队”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
team 意为“队、齐心”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这支齐心就是那件事的全部。
team 意为“齐心”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那支队，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
team 意为“队；团队”，指秩序册里写到、被清点的那一支，到 1986 年这一支成了秩序册里的一行。
team 意为“队之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的队之事是一处体育场和三个年份的清点。
team 意为“队；团队”，我记得的是秩序册里清点过的那一支，1988 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一支。
team 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，队是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的队。
